_note: Origin of every prompt asset. Keys under assets are relative to text_prompts/; keys under repository_assets are relative to the repository root. Assets carrying an inline '_provenance' key are authoritative. Regenerate the report with scripts/audit_prompt_provenance.py.

focus.note: No checked-in FOCUS CSV is a verbatim copy of an upstream prompt file. CAMELYON16, TCGA-NSCLC, and UBC-OCEAN use locally rewritten wording for tasks that do have upstream banks. TCGA-BRCA and TCGA-RCC use locally generated banks for tasks with no prompt CSV in the FOCUS release. The two root-level legacy CSVs are local classname templates, not copies of the richer focus/ files.

unused_upstream_task_bank.train_data/gpt/description/BRCA.json: Upstream High/Low breast-cancer recurrence/grade task; it is not an IDC/ILC subtype bank and is therefore not used for this benchmark's TCGA-BRCA cohort.

mscpt.note: The benchmark uses verbatim upstream description banks for TCGA-NSCLC, TCGA-RCC, and UBC-OCEAN. TCGA-BRCA IDC/ILC and CAMELYON16 have no task-matched upstream MSCPT bank and use locally generated descriptions. The upstream Lung.json copy is deliberately preserved, but its LUSC block contains nine descriptions with adenocarcinoma-associated morphology; see repository_assets for the exact indices.

generated_or_rewritten: prompt_spec-compiled CAMELYON16 and UBC-OCEAN benchmark banks

selected_prompt_banks.UBC-OCEAN: generated MAPLE task extension using released MSCPT UBC descriptions; not an upstream MAPLE bank

upstream_runtime_issue.note: PromptLearner emits class attributes entity-major, but the released view(n_cls, num_entities).permute assumes class-major input. This silently associates most entity/class logits with the wrong attribute descriptions. PGVL restores the emitted entity-major shape directly.

maple.note: The three released JSON files are byte-exact copies pinned by SHA-256. Class-key order is part of the classifier contract because MAPLE forms logits in dictionary insertion order; the doctor and runtime now reject reordered global_info or entity attributes. MAPLE publishes no UBC-OCEAN or CAMELYON16 bank, so those conditions are never reported as upstream.

pathpt.note: Native PathPT uses the upstream 22 templates and synonym banks verbatim for BRCA, UBC-OCEAN, and CAMELYON. NSCLC and RCC are explicit generated task extensions because upstream PathPT defines neither bank. The CAMELYON Normal bank preserves the upstream missing-comma concatenation and discloses it rather than silently changing the prompt condition.

task_extensions.TCGA-BRCA: The released task-agnostic instance prototypes are used, but TOP publishes no BRCA bag initializer; the bag learner starts from random context plus the configured IDC/ILC classnames.
task_extensions.TCGA-RCC: No released TOP RCC bag initializer; the example config uses the upstream instance bank with random classname bag context.
task_extensions.UBC-OCEAN: No released TOP ovarian bag initializer; the example config uses the upstream instance bank with random classname bag context.

top.note: The 26 instance prototypes are copied from knowledge_from_chatGPT in the released training code, not reconstructed from the six examples displayed in the supplement. Standard NSCLC and CAMELYON declarations use the exact active bagPrompt_ctx_init code literals, including ten learnable slots. The longer NSCLC descriptions from supplementary Figure 4 remain available only as an explicitly unwired alternative condition.

slip.note: The released banks have three distinct roles: templates, slide_classnames, and nested tissue_classnames. Each nested tissue pair is encoded as two prompts and averaged upstream. Earlier PGVL assets joined each pair into one 'Name: description' sentence and omitted the other roles, so they preserved words but not embeddings. The selected TCGA-NSCLC bank now copies the complete upstream structure exactly. Generated cohort extensions are explicitly labeled and losslessly expanded to the same two-text runtime shape.

cod_mil.note: The 27-row RCC CSV and all three released tensors are preserved. The released CLIP-RN50 tensor is audit-only because its 30 positional rows do not match the CSV. The selected verified CLIP-RN50 tensor is a local, exact re-encoding of the unchanged upstream CSV. The encoder-agnostic builder can produce equivalently verified PLIP or QuiltNet banks for matching patch feature spaces.

wsi_five.note: NSCLC native mode uses the released six questions, authors' per-case answers, and verbatim LUAD/LUSC evaluation descriptions. Each training candidate bank is derived only from that fold's training cases. BRCA, RCC, and UBC-OCEAN question sets are local task extensions and cannot reproduce the released lung supervision condition; simplified modes use their questions with classname comparison and never consume report text.

known_content_issue.note: A missing comma concatenates 'non-cancerous tissue' and 'normal breast tissue' into one prompt synonym.

methods/pathpt/prompts.py.note: Defines only the locally authored NSCLC/RCC synonym sets and routing metadata; upstream banks and templates are imported from the separately registered vendored _utils.py.

known_content_issue.note: These LUSC entries describe glandular/acinar architecture, mucin production, lepidic growth, signet-ring cells, bronchioloalveolar carcinoma, or micropapillary morphology associated with lung adenocarcinoma. They contribute to the LUSC text representation. The file remains unchanged so an upstream prompt run is not silently converted into a local condition.
